whatHappened.title: Let's start with what happened
whatHappened.body: The date is already filled in — change it if the animal was found earlier. Pick the kind of incident if you can, or choose “Not sure”. Then describe what happened in your own words.

animal.title: What animal is it?
animal.body: Only if you know. “Not sure” is a completely normal answer here — a short description like “small brown bird” is more useful than a guessed species.

location.title: Where is it?
location.body: You can use your device location (with your permission) or just describe the place. “Roadside near the old mill” is a perfectly good location.

observations.title: What did you see?
observations.body: Describe what you can see — movement, bleeding, entanglement — rather than guessing an injury. Use the example chips if they help.

hazards.title: Is anything dangerous right now?
hazards.body: Think traffic, water, pets — for the animal and for you. Your safety comes first, always.

actionsDone.title: What has already been done?
actionsDone.body: Even “no action taken” is useful information for the next person. Don't feel you should handle the animal.

animalNow.title: Where is the animal now?
animalNow.body: Still there? Contained? With someone? This becomes the start of the custody story.

contacts.title: Would you like to be contacted?
contacts.body: Completely optional. Anonymous reports are fine — skip this if you prefer.

photos.title: Photos help a lot
photos.body: If you have them. A photo of the animal and its surroundings gives the next person real context. Skip if you don't.

review.title: Almost done — review
review.body: Check the summary. Anything you didn't know stays honestly marked as Unknown. Choose how the report should be shared, then create it.
